note: Set A binds the laundry-section dimensions (2' - 5 1/16" width, 7' - 0 1/8" height) and the bulkhead, platform and clearances correctly, while Set B omits both laundry dimensions and adds a misbound East Island "component width" of 3' - 0" (that value is a counter/height dimension) plus a trivial, garbled MWB02 "component type" claim. Set B also repeats the same facts more often (platform height 6" twice, the 3' - 0" height restated three times as Island, East Island and "millwork unit"), and its quote for the MWB02 claim is a text-layer fragment. Set A's weaknesses are vaguer entities ("millwork", "millwork section") and a spurious "inches" unit on two material values, and it misses the 3' - 3 3/4" North Island dimensions that B captures. On balance A is the cleaner, better-bound set.
remarks: Both sets treat the 5" value twice, once as backsplash height and once as East Island countertop thickness; the page shows two 5" callouts but a 5" countertop thickness is questionable and one of these bindings may be wrong in both sets. Both sets also omit the 2' - 0" and 6 1/2" dimensions present in the text layer. Set A appends the unit 'inches' to material specifications (1/2" MDF FIN. W/ P3, 3/4" MDF GABLE FIN. W/ P3), which is a unit/formatting error rather than a content error. Set B's quote 'MWB02 CTION CENTER MODU' is a text-layer overlap artifact and should not be used as evidentiary text.
